claims.statement: For a physical selector coordinate i, the canonical occurrence KL admits the exact four-term split into singleton-reference mismatch, residual-shape KL, mean-occurrence reference mismatch, and conditional selector-occurrence mutual information, as equation (3.3) of REPORT.md.
claims.scope: Every nonconstant Boolean gate at interior product bias with nonzero residual packet mass M=v-b; boundary/singleton cases by the stated limit.

claims.statement: If rho<=1/2 and the selector-occurrence posterior crossing c_occ is at least gamma rho, then v K_occ is at least gamma(p-b) log2((1-rho)/rho) plus the explicit singleton and mean-reference mismatch KL terms.
claims.scope: Exact actual residual packet source; no arbitrary-row relaxation.

claims.rejected_statement: A universal positive lower bound K_occ >= F(d) depending only on physical selector disagreement d for all interior Boolean selector splits.
claims.counterexample: Any nonconstant binary Boolean gate such as AND_2 has K_occ=0 while a selector disagreement probability is strictly between 0 and 1 at interior bias.

claims.statement: For every dangerous rare-disagreement selector step, either fractional selector-occurrence crossing supplies logarithmic K_occ, or the explicit mismatch/hierarchy/child-potential terms pay the remaining scalar mean packet entropy with one dimension-independent bound.
